title: REPLAY: Trump accuses NATO of 'foolish mistake' over Strait of Hormuz
summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday said the United States ​had been informed by most of its NATO allies that they did not want to get involved with the country's military ​operation ‌in Iran, a move he described ⁠as a "very foolish mistake". Trump's remarks came as he hosted Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin in the Oval Office to mark St Patrick's Day.
